name: Vehicle Rental System
author: SCUMSA
description: Players rent a vehicle from in-game chat or a Discord menu, pay with their own money or gold, and get it spawned beside them. No admin has to be online. The plugin runs the whole rental: reminders, extensions, early return, and removing the vehicle when the time is up. Discord is optional.

needs.why: Prices a rental against the balance the running game holds this second, and places the vehicle where the player is standing now. With these off both come from the last server save: a player can spend their money elsewhere and still rent on credit, and the vehicle appears where they stood at that save.

Tells which vehicle a rental spawned, and whether it is still there, from the running game. With this off both come from the last server save, so a vehicle spawned since then can be reported as gone and left standing when the rental is returned.
